prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's all right.
Q: Understood. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas, heading toward the freeway. Traffic was moderate and the lanes were fairly wide.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to the right because the lane ahead had slowed. I checked my mirror and saw nothing close, so I signaled and started to move over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until it was already alongside me. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car shove to the left. I didn't see it coming up in my blind spot.
Q: Which part of your vehicle made contact with the other car?
A: The right side of my car, near the rear door and the back panel. The other car's left side was damaged too, from what I could see afterward.
Q: Did you or the other driver stop after the collision?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and the other driver seemed shaken but okay.
Q: You mentioned an injury. Where do you feel it, and when did you first notice it?
A: My right knee. It hit the steering column or the door frame when the car jolted. I felt pain almost right away, and it got worse over the next day or two.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider for the knee?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same week and I've been following up with my own doctor since then. They've recommended imaging and some physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your account?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful and I signaled before moving over. That's everything I can recall right now.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
